IC1: A. Histologically proven breast cancer confirmed by biopsy [OR] or pathological examination of the resected tumor.
IC2: B. Histologically confirmed breast cancer patients, fulfilling any of the following:
IC3: 1. Multiple bone metastases indicated by bone scan
IC4: 2. Bone scan positive, [AND] and proven by other imaging examinations, including computed tomography (CT), magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) [OR] and X-ray.
IC5: 3. Bone scan positive, [AND] with clinical symptoms, including bone pain, [OR] pathologic fracture, [OR] spinal cord compression and so on.
